items.markdown:
You can purchase or set up an Asana subscription directly through the official [Asana Pricing Page](https://asana.com/pricing).

#### Available Plans

- **Personal** — **$0** (Free forever for up to 2 users)
	- Best for personal to-dos, simple task tracking, and unlimited projects.[[1]](https://asana.com/pricing)
- **Starter** — **$10.99** per user/month (billed annually) or $13.49 billed monthly
	- Best for small teams that need project timelines, Gantt charts, and Asana AI features.[[1]](https://asana.com/pricing)
- **Advanced** — **$24.99** per user/month (billed annually) or $30.49 billed monthly
	- Best for growing teams managing goals, portfolios, and capacity planning.[[1]](https://asana.com/pricing)
- **Enterprise** — **Custom pricing** 
	- Best for large organizations requiring advanced compliance (SAML, SCIM) and dedicated controls.[[1]](https://asana.com/pricing)

To help you pick the right option, **how many team members** will be using Asana, and do you need features like **timeline/Gantt views** or **AI tools**?
